WAVE LOADING 3 WEEKS - STRENGTH BLOCK (my own version, don't judge lol)

Training max: Sq 405lb / Bp 275lb / Dl 495lb / OHP 165lb  (round to 5)

Week 1 (volume)
Day 1 Squat: 5x5 @ 70%, then 1x AMRAP @ 70% (target 10)
Day 1 Accessory: Leg press 3x12, ham curl 3x12, abs wheel 3x10
Day 2 Bench: 5x5 @ 70%, 1xAMRAP, then 3x10 incline DB 60lb
Day 2 Accessory: Pull-ups 4xAMRAP, face pull 3x20
Day 3 Deadlift: 4x5 @ 75%, 1xAMRAP, deficit pull 3x5 @ 60%
Day 4 OHP: 5x5 @ 75%, chin ups 4x8, lateral raises 4x15

Week 2 (intensity)
Day 1 Squat: 3x3 @ 80%, 1x3+ @ 85% (stop at RPE 9), back-off 3x5 @ 70%
Day 2 Bench: 3x3 @ 80%, 1x3+ @ 85%, back-off 3x5
Day 3 Deadlift: 3x3 @ 85%, 2x3 @ 80%
Day 4 OHP: 3x3 @ 82.5%, ...same accessories

Week 3 (peak)
Day 1 Squat: work up to a heavy single @ 95%, then 2x2 @ 87.5%
Day 2 Bench: work up to heavy single @ 95%, 3x3 @ 80%
Day 3 Deadlift: single @ 95%, then 3x2 @ 85%
Day 4 OHP: heavy 3 @ 90%
(deload week after: all weights 60%, 3 sets of 5)

Note: when I travel I train at a gym with kg plates only: 100kg = 220lb. 
Bodyweight 191lb (86.6kg). Don't forget creatine + 8h sleep.
